lines.zh: 我贴着树影飞，翅面是淡灰的。
lines.en: I fly along the tree shadows, my wings pale grey.

lines.zh: 这一对翅膀比我身子还宽。
lines.en: My wingspan is wider than my body.

lines.zh: 丛林的湿气托着我往上。
lines.en: The jungle damp lifts me higher.
I circle half the canopy.

lines.zh: 阳光从叶隙漏下来，我躲开。
lines.en: Sunlight leaks through the leaves; I avoid it.
I beat my wings slowly to save strength.

lines.zh: 我从这朵花飞到下一朵。
lines.en: I fly from one bloom to the next.

lines.zh: 灰白的翅尖在暗处很显眼。
lines.en: The pale wingtips stand out in the dark.
I follow a vine upward.
The air under the canopy is warm and close.

lines.zh: 我在叶子背面停了一下。
lines.en: I pause on the underside of a leaf.

lines.zh: 我飞得快，翅膀划开空气。
lines.en: I fly fast, my wings slicing the air.

lines.zh: 我躲开一只扑过来的鸟。
lines.en: I dodge a bird that lunges at me.
Higher up, the wind turns cool.
I work my way up a block at a time.

lines.zh: 灰翅在树皮旁边几乎看不出。
lines.en: Against bark my grey wings nearly vanish.
I rest on a broad leaf.
My wings fold slowly shut.
No sun reaches here.

lines.zh: 灰翅并拢，我蹭了蹭叶面
lines.en: Grey wings closed, I rub against the leaf.
The leaf is dripping.
I hear wings far off.
That sound is not from me.
My life is not a long one.
I rest a while before flying again.
The heat softens my wings.
The leaf veins look like little roads.
I close my wings into a single sheet.
You looked up and saw me.
I have landed on your hat brim.
Do not move; I am resting.
Your breath rocks me.

lines.zh: 我翅上的灰在光里发白。
lines.en: The grey on my wings looks white in the light.
You are looking very closely.
My wing is made of fine scales.
Reach for me and I leave.

lines.zh: 我翅上那道灰，被你盯住
lines.en: You have fixed on the grey band on my wing.
There is an old notch in my wing.
A little of my wing is torn.
I fly a little crooked.
I settle on a leaf.
With this wound I can still manage.

lines.zh: 灰粉撒在你手心，翅面发暗
lines.en: Grey dust on your palm; my wing dulls.
I fold my wings to shield them.
The wind stings as it passes.
I rest for a good while.
I can still fly.
Only not quickly.
The smell of poppies.
Did you pick one?
Let me settle on it.
This nectar is not rich.
I am not fussy about flowers, only their colour.
There is pollen on your hands.
I will rest on your finger a moment.
Do not close your hand.
This one is open at its best.

lines.zh: 虞美人一朵，够我吸一口
lines.en: One poppy is enough for a sip.
One finger wipes off my scales.
There is a mark pressed into my wing.
I lift off and away.

lines.zh: 你的指头比我的翅还宽
lines.en: Your finger is wider than my wing.
You block the wind.
I fly to your other side.
Your fingers are too thick.

lines.zh: 我在你手背上收起灰翅
lines.en: I fold my grey wings on the back of your hand.

lines.zh: 你手指一颤，我又离了枝
lines.en: Your finger twitches; I leave the twig again.
This is just right.
This season I look for a mate.
Did you see that other one too?
Its wings are darker than mine.
I wait for it higher up.
Please do not disturb us.
We only fly for one season.
It has already flown past.
The wind will carry the scent.
Step back a little first.
I am going now.
There is a drop of water on the leaf.
I settle and touch it.
It is not nectar.
I lift off for somewhere else.
A fallen flower lies on the ground.

lines.zh: 那朵落花灰扑扑的，不甜
lines.en: That fallen flower is dusty grey and not sweet.
It has already dried.
I settle on a patch of moss.
The smell here is faint.
I carry nothing away.
Something is watching me.
I climb higher.
The net's shadow falls; I shoot upward.
I slip behind the tree.
You are holding a net.
I know what that is.
Do not come closer.
There is netting on that stick.
I hold still on the leaf stem.
Your shadow comes closer.
You are still following me.
I weave between the leaves.
Your net is held high.
I will not fly there.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了一片叶。
lines.en: Your shadow covers a leaf.
I move into the light.
You cannot see the grey on my wings.
I press to the bark like moss.

lines.zh: 我在你的影子里穿过去。
lines.en: I pass through your shadow.
Your hand stops in midair.
I have nothing to strike with.
One blow would tear my wings.
You have me pinned.
All I can do is struggle.
Scale dust falls on your hand.
I pull upward once.
A thread has caught my leg.
You are holding too tightly.
Your fingerprints are on my wing.
I kick at your knuckle.
Dawn comes and I leave the leaf.
My wings are still damp.
Let me dry in the sun a while.
There are plenty of flowers here.

lines.zh: 丛林里的大翅，先展开半截。
lines.en: Half these jungle wings unfold first.
The pale grey catches the light first.
I fly half a block and stop.
This wood would do.
The jungle flowers have only just opened.
Last night's rain is still on the leaves.

lines.zh: 热浪一过，翅膀就卷边了。
lines.en: The heat passes and my wings curl at the edges.
I drop from the air into the grass.

lines.zh: 水把我粘在水面，我扑翅。
lines.en: Water glues me to its surface; I beat my wings.
The blast throws me against bark.
A grain of sand punches through my wingtip.
That light stiffens my wings.
Without nectar I fly slower and slower.

lines.zh: 雷落下来的光刺得我睁不开眼。
lines.en: The flash leaves me blinded.
Everything around me drops away.
